newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Nov trade surplus 2.246 billion DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish Nov trade surplus 2.246 billion DKK.

text.p: Denmark posted a trade surplus, excluding ships, of 2.246 billion crowns ($349.1 million) in November 1996 compared to a revised 1.948-billion crowns surplus in October, the national statistics office said on Wednesday.
Seasonally adjusted, the surplus was 1.479 billion crowns in November, compared to 2.154 the month before.

NOTE - Analysts polled by Reuters predicted an average November trade surplus excluding ships of 2.7 billion crowns, 2.2 billion crowns seasonally adjusted. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
